description: This file defines a PHP class 'InfoArray' within the OrangeHRM maintenance module. The class encapsulates two arrays, matchArray and parameterArray, initialized via the constructor from a provided associative array. It provides getter methods to access these arrays.

classes.name: InfoArray
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class that encapsulates match and parameter arrays, initialized from an input array.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes matchArray and parameterArray from a strategy info array.

methods.name: getMatchArray
methods.description: Returns the match array, or null if not set.

methods.name: getParameterArray
methods.description: Returns the parameter array, or null if not set.
